entities.summary: José Miguel "Txemi" Urtasun Uriz is a Spanish professional basketball player for Ourense of the LEB Oro. He is a 6-foot-4-inch (1.93 m) tall shooting guard. His twin brother, Álex Urtasun, is also a professional basketball player.
